purpose: Public-safe governance rules for Chill Bro private knowledge and live web research. Private document identifiers and contents belong in the protected ingestion system, not this repository.
rules: Internal Chill Pros and FieldForge approved pricing, PM programs, SOPs and policy override public web content for company operations.
Exact OEM documentation overrides third-party sources for model-specific specifications, wiring, sequence of operation and service values.
Never infer a part number from appearance alone when model/serial or OEM evidence is required.
Conflicting sources must be surfaced rather than averaged together.
Customer-facing, unrelated business, or personal Drive documents are excluded from the Chill Bro corpus.
Private source IDs, URLs, pricing values, SOP text and proprietary FieldForge data must never be committed to this public repository.
